MartialA.title: Warrior
MartialA.already: More attack damage; shields slow you less.

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.description: Shout: you and allies within 8 blocks get Strength I for 8 s; enemies within 8 blocks get Weakness I for 5 s.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Strike with your shield: the enemy in front takes 4 damage, is knocked back 3 blocks and is stunned for 1 s. Needs a shield.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.description: Taunt every enemy within 10 blocks to attack you for 6 s; you take 15% less damage while they do.

MartialA.title: Archer
MartialA.already: No arrow spread; bows slow you less.

abilities.name: Arrow Rain
abilities.description: A volley of 10 arrows falls on the spot you look at (within 24 blocks), spread over 4 blocks.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: Your next arrow roots the target in place for 3 s.

abilities.name: Quiver Refill
abilities.description: Conjure 16 arrows into your inventory (once every 2 minutes).

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Throw a smoke cloud (4 blocks, 6 s): enemies inside get Blindness and lose track of you; you get Invisibility while inside.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Become invisible for 6 s and drop the aggro of every enemy within 16 blocks.

abilities.name: Caltrops
abilities.description: Scatter caltrops in a 3-block area for 10 s: enemies walking over them take 2 damage and get Slowness II.

MartialA.title: Beastmaster
MartialA.already: Tamed animals are stronger and share your potions.

abilities.name: Mend Beast
abilities.description: Heal every tamed animal within 12 blocks for 10 and give them Regeneration I for 10 s.

abilities.name: Feral Bond
abilities.description: For 12 s you share damage with your nearest tamed animal: each of you takes half of what either takes.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.description: 3 summoned boars charge forward 12 blocks, knocking enemies aside and dealing 5 damage each.

MartialA.title: Cavalry
MartialA.already: Better tamed horses; no fall damage mounted.

abilities.name: Mounted Charge
abilities.description: While riding: your mount surges forward for 3 s at double speed; enemies you run into take 6 damage and are knocked back.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.description: While riding: enemies within 2 blocks of your mount take 3 damage a second for 6 s.

abilities.name: Unhorse
abilities.description: Knock the target off whatever it rides and stun it for 2 s.

MartialA.title: Duelist
MartialA.already: +10% damage when the target is alone; parries restore stamina.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.description: Thrust forward 4 blocks along the ground, hitting the first enemy for +50% damage.

abilities.name: Flourish
abilities.description: A quick 3-hit combo on the enemy in front, each hit 60% of your attack damage.

abilities.name: Riposte Stance
abilities.description: For 6 s, every melee hit you take is answered with an automatic counter for 75% of your attack damage.

MartialB.title: Guardian
MartialB.already: Guarding costs less stamina; nearby players take 5% less damage.

abilities.name: Intercept
abilities.description: Mark an ally for 10 s: 40% of the damage it takes is redirected to you.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: For 6 s, allies standing behind you take 30% less damage from the front.

abilities.name: Taunting Shout
abilities.description: Every enemy within 10 blocks is forced to attack you for 5 s.

abilities.name: Harrier
abilities.description: For 10 s, each hit you land on a different enemy gives +5% speed (stacks 5 times).

abilities.name: Throwing Knives
abilities.description: Throw 3 knives in a fan, 4 damage each.

abilities.name: Tripwire
abilities.description: Place an invisible tripwire trap: the first enemy to cross it is knocked down (stunned) for 2 s and slowed for 4 s.

MartialB.title: Crossbowman
MartialB.already: Faster crossbow reload; bolts pierce one extra target.

abilities.name: Volley Fire
abilities.description: Fire 3 bolts at once in a narrow spread from your loaded crossbow.

abilities.name: Pavise
abilities.description: Plant a wooden shield for 15 s that blocks projectiles coming from the front.

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Crouch still for 2 s: your next bolt crits for +75% damage.

abilities.name: Skewer
abilities.description: A long thrust that hits every enemy in a 5-block line in front of you.

abilities.name: Sweep the Legs
abilities.description: Spin your spear: every enemy within 4 blocks is knocked down (stunned) for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Pike Wall
abilities.description: A row of spikes rises from the ground in front of you for 8 s; enemies touching them take 3 damage a second.

MartialB.title: Monster Hunter
MartialB.already: +15% damage to undead and arthropods; extra drops.

abilities.name: Silver Oil
abilities.description: For 20 s your weapon deals +4 damage to undead and sets them on fire.

abilities.name: Monster Lore
abilities.description: Look at a creature: it glows for 15 s and takes 15% more damage from you and your allies.

abilities.name: Trophy Strength
abilities.description: Each undead or arthropod you killed in the last 60 s gives +2% damage (up to 20%) for 30 s.

MartialB.title: Bounty Hunter
MartialB.already: +10% damage to illagers and witches; captains drop emeralds.

abilities.name: Bola
abilities.description: Throw a bola that wraps the target: it is rooted for 3 s and can't attack for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Tracker's Instinct
abilities.description: Every illager, witch and pillager within 48 blocks glows for 20 s.

abilities.name: Hired Muscle
abilities.description: Summon a vindicator mercenary that fights for you for 30 s.

MartialC.title: Battle Mage
MartialC.already: Spells cost 10% less mana within 3 s of a melee hit.

abilities.name: Mana Burst
abilities.description: Spend 30 mana: an arcane blast around you deals 6 damage and knocks enemies back 4 blocks.

abilities.name: Runic Strike
abilities.description: Your next melee hit releases a magic missile at the nearest other enemy.

abilities.name: Overchannel
abilities.description: For 8 s, spells cost 30% more mana but deal 25% more damage.

MartialC.title: Sentinel
MartialC.already: Resistance I after standing still 2 s; projectiles deal 20% less.

abilities.name: Watchtower
abilities.description: Plant yourself for 8 s: you can't move but gain Resistance II and +30% ranged damage.

abilities.name: Arrow Deflection
abilities.description: For 5 s, projectiles that hit you bounce back at their shooter.

abilities.name: Lookout
abilities.description: For 20 s, every enemy within 40 blocks glows and you get Night Vision.

abilities.name: Holy Smite
abilities.description: A light strikes the target for 6 damage (12 to undead) and blinds it for 2 s.

abilities.name: Consecrate
abilities.description: Bless the ground in 4 blocks for 8 s: undead in it take 3 damage a second and burn.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Become immune to damage for 2 s but deal 50% less damage for 6 s.

MartialC.title: Corsair
MartialC.already: +15% damage in a boat or ship; can't drown for 15 s.

abilities.name: Boarding Hook
abilities.description: Fire a grappling hook that pulls the target to you.

abilities.name: Sea Shanty
abilities.description: For 15 s, you and allies within 10 blocks get +10% attack speed and Water Breathing.

abilities.name: Riptide Slash
abilities.description: Swing a wave forward: enemies in a 5-block cone take 5 damage and are pushed back; stronger in water.

MartialC.title: Zealot
MartialC.already: Stamina regenerates 10% faster below half health.

abilities.name: Flagellate
abilities.description: Lose 4 health to gain Strength II and Speed I for 10 s.

abilities.name: Martyrdom
abilities.description: For 10 s, damage you take heals every ally within 8 blocks for half of it.

abilities.name: Burning Faith
abilities.description: Your melee hits set targets on fire for 6 s; you get Fire Resistance while it lasts (12 s).

abilities.name: Temper Armour
abilities.description: You and an ally you look at gain +3 armour and +1 toughness for 30 s.

abilities.name: Hammer Strike
abilities.description: A heavy blow for +50% damage that shreds 3 armour from the target for 8 s.

abilities.name: Forge Heat
abilities.description: Smelt every raw ore in your inventory instantly (once every 5 minutes).

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.description: Clear every negative effect from you and allies within 6 blocks.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: A 5-block circle for 10 s: allies in it heal 1 health a second; enemies can't hit from inside it.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.description: Undead within 10 blocks flee from you for 6 s and get Weakness II.

JobA.title: Cook
JobA.already: Better crafted food; more smoker XP.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Lay out a feast for 20 s: players who stand by it regenerate health and hunger and get Strength I for 2 minutes.

abilities.name: Iron Stomach
abilities.description: Cure poison, hunger and nausea and become immune to them for 60 s.

abilities.name: Spice Mix
abilities.description: For 5 minutes, every food you eat also gives Speed I and Regeneration I for 10 s.

JobA.title: Farmer
JobA.already: More crop drops; better bone meal.

abilities.name: Bountiful Harvest
abilities.description: Every crop within 6 blocks grows one stage instantly.

abilities.name: Scarecrow
abilities.description: Place a scarecrow for 60 s: hostile mobs within 8 blocks get Slowness I and target it first.

abilities.name: Compost
abilities.description: Turn rotten flesh, seeds and saplings in your inventory into bone meal.

abilities.name: Coin Toss
abilities.description: Throw a gold coin: on heads you get Luck II and Speed I for 20 s; on tails the target takes 6 damage.

abilities.name: Bribe
abilities.description: Spend 3 emeralds: the hostile mob you look at stops attacking you for 15 s.

abilities.name: Caravan Guard
abilities.description: Summon an iron-golem guard for 30 s (once every 5 minutes).

abilities.name: Herd Call
abilities.description: Every farm animal within 24 blocks walks to you.

abilities.name: Fatten Up
abilities.description: Baby animals within 8 blocks grow up instantly.

abilities.name: Branding Iron
abilities.description: Brand a creature: it glows for 60 s and drops double loot if you kill it.

JobB.title: Miner
JobB.already: Faster stone mining; no mining exhaustion.

abilities.name: Hard Hat
abilities.description: For 30 s: Resistance I and immunity to damage from falling blocks and suffocation.

abilities.name: Miner's Lamp
abilities.description: Night Vision for 3 minutes and a 5-block light that follows you.

abilities.name: Pickaxe Strike
abilities.description: A heavy blow with a pickaxe for +60% damage that shreds 4 armour for 8 s.

JobB.title: Lumberjack
JobB.already: Fells whole trees; more planks from logs.

abilities.name: Log Throw
abilities.description: Hurl a log that rolls 10 blocks forward, hitting enemies for 6 damage and knocking them back.

abilities.name: Woodsman's Grit
abilities.description: For 15 s: Resistance I and Haste II.

abilities.name: Forest Friend
abilities.description: In a forest biome: Regeneration I and +10% speed for 30 s.

JobB.title: Explorer
JobB.already: Explorer kit; no sprint exhaustion; Trailblazer.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Restore all your stamina and hunger once every 5 minutes.

abilities.name: Pathfinder
abilities.description: For 30 s: +20% speed and step up full blocks without jumping.

abilities.name: Grappling Rope
abilities.description: Fire a rope that pulls the creature you hit toward you (no pulling yourself).

JobB.title: Alchemist
JobB.already: Helpful effects last 25% longer; XP from brewing.

abilities.name: Acid Flask
abilities.description: Throw a flask that deals 4 damage and shreds 4 armour from everything in 3 blocks for 8 s.

abilities.name: Elixir of Vigor
abilities.description: Drink: Strength I, Speed I and Haste I for 30 s.

abilities.name: Volatile Mix
abilities.description: Throw a flask that bursts into a random harmful cloud (poison, slowness, weakness or blindness) for 6 s.

JobB.title: Sailor
JobB.already: Breath lasts twice as long; ships you steer go 15% faster.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description: For 30 s the boat or ship you ride goes 40% faster.

abilities.name: Deep Breath
abilities.description: Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 60 s.

abilities.name: Weather Eye
abilities.description: See the weather for the next 10 minutes and get Conduit Power for 30 s.

JobB.title: Fisher
JobB.already: Fish bite sooner, catches can double; fish feeds more.

abilities.name: Hook and Reel
abilities.description: Cast a hook that pulls the creature you hit 6 blocks toward you.

abilities.name: Chum the Water
abilities.description: For 60 s, fish bite twice as fast within 8 blocks of the spot you look at.

abilities.name: Net Throw
abilities.description: Throw a net that roots every creature in a 3-block area for 3 s.

JobC.title: Bard
JobC.already: Goat horn rallies nearby players; +10% XP near other players.

abilities.name: Song of Courage
abilities.description: For 20 s, allies within 10 blocks get +10% attack damage and +10% attack speed.

abilities.name: Lullaby
abilities.description: Enemies within 8 blocks fall asleep (can't move or attack) for 4 s or until hit.

abilities.name: Encore
abilities.description: Refresh the duration of every positive effect on allies within 10 blocks.

JobC.title: Herbalist
JobC.already: More flowers when picking; suspicious stew lasts twice as long.

abilities.name: Poultice
abilities.description: Heal yourself or the ally you look at for 8 and stop bleeding and poison.

abilities.name: Thornbush
abilities.description: A ring of thorny bushes grows around you for 10 s; enemies that touch it take 2 damage and are slowed.

abilities.name: Healing Garden
abilities.description: Flowers bloom in a 4-block circle for 12 s; allies in it get Regeneration I.

JobC.title: Beekeeper
JobC.already: Bees never sting you; extra honeycomb from hives.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: Release 4 bees that attack the enemy you look at for 15 s (they don't die after stinging).

abilities.name: Honey Trap
abilities.description: Throw honey on the ground for 8 s: enemies in a 3-block patch are slowed heavily and can't jump.

abilities.name: Stinger Shot
abilities.description: Fire 3 stingers that deal 3 damage and Poison I for 4 s each.

JobC.title: Gravedigger
JobC.already: Faster with shovels; extra undead loot; starts with a lantern.

abilities.name: Shovel Slam
abilities.description: A wide shovel swing: enemies in a 3-block arc take +40% damage and are knocked down for 1 s.

abilities.name: Rest in Peace
abilities.description: Undead within 6 blocks are stunned for 3 s and take 6 damage.

abilities.name: Mourner's Veil
abilities.description: For 15 s, undead ignore you unless you attack them.
